name: Running Brook Camps Day Camp
description_short: Co-ed day camp at Chapel Hill-Chauncy Hall School in Waltham for children from age 3.5 through completed 6th grade, run in two-week sessions. Activities include arts and crafts, drama, gym games, and nature, with archery, a challenge course, and STEM for older campers. Snack and lunch are provided.
